errors.text: The proposed refractory W-Ni-Fe-Ta alloy and precipitation treatment do not reconstruct the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy or its FCC/B2 lamellar initial state.
The central intervention is cold rolling plus annealing rather than the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment, so the decisive pressure-dependent hypothesis is not tested.
